reports.title: AUTODESK, INC. ANNOUNCES FISCAL 2027 THIRD QUARTER RESULTS

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section:
Q4 FY27 Guidance Metrics | Q4 FY27(ending January 31, 2027)
Revenue (in millions) | $2,220 - $2,235
GAAP EPS (2) | $2.64 - $3.02
Non-GAAP EPS | $3.21 - $3.26

desk.headline: Revenue up 17% to $2.16bn and adjusted EPS of $3.20, both above estimates; full-year revenue and billings outlook raised
results: Revenue rose 17% to $2.16bn (14% in constant currency), above the $2.13bn estimate; adjusted EPS of $3.20 beat the $3.07 estimate.
Architecture, engineering and construction led with revenue up 19% to $1.10bn; AutoCAD rose 11% and Manufacturing 13%.
The recently bought MaintainX is now included in the numbers and in the outlook.
GAAP EPS of $2.68 was helped by a one-off tax benefit of about $105m; GAAP operating margin held at 26%.
Free cash flow was $505m (+17%); Autodesk spent $1.25bn on buybacks in the first nine months.

guidance.summary: Autodesk raised the middle of its full-year revenue and billings ranges, despite a stronger dollar. Q4 revenue is guided to $2.220–2.235bn and full-year adjusted EPS to $12.70–12.76, just above the analyst estimate.

points: Management pointed to steady strength in construction and emerging markets, and strong renewal rates.
MaintainX added almost $33m of revenue in its first quarter; management said it is performing well.
Western Europe is still slow to recover from the sales reorganisation, and the stronger dollar is a headwind.
Management expects Q4 growth to slow against a tough comparison, and kept its target of a 41% adjusted margin by FY29.
Autodesk plans about $1.5bn of buybacks this year; it signed its largest-ever enterprise agreement in the quarter.
call.source: Call coverage: Investing.com, 25 Nov 2026; Securities.io, 24 Nov 2026; Trend & Ticker, 24 Nov 2026

watch: How much Q4 growth slows against the tough comparison from last year.
Recovery in Western Europe after the sales reorganisation.
MaintainX integration and the effect of a stronger dollar on billings.
